title: Silicon Sample Benchmark — Tier 3 (direct effect forecast) submission (team team_28)
description: This Tier 3 entry uses a literature-conditioned multi-model ensemble to directly forecast treatment effects. The ensemble combines predictions from GPT-4o, GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Qwen3.8-27B. Qwen3.8-27B contributes two HippoRAG-based prediction series: one using the standard HippoRAG ranking and one using PIT-normalized fusion of 0.7 × graph and 0.3 × dense retrieval. The two Qwen series are averaged first, after which the four model-level prediction series are combined with equal weight. All predictions are calibrated and reported as average treatment effects for 16 interventions across 13 outcomes.
